cards.text: All the people of Judah take Uzziah, son of King Amaziah, and make him king in his father's place. He's SIXTEEN, friend. Sixteen and running a kingdom, and I still can't run an oven timer without burning a batch.
After his father Amaziah rests with his fathers, Uzziah rebuilds the town of Eloth and restores it to Judah. He reigns in Jerusalem FIFTY-TWO years, and his mother Jecoliah is from Jerusalem.

cards.question: True or false: young King Uzziah does what is right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.

cards.text: And this young king doesn't figure it all out alone. He seeks God all through the days of Zechariah, who instructs him in the fear of God.

cards.question: Here's what this whole story hangs on. As long as Uzziah seeks the LORD, what does God give him?

cards.text: Uzziah goes to war against the Philistines and tears down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. That's not a battle, friend, that's a DEMOLITION CREW.

cards.question: After tearing down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod, what does King Uzziah do near Ashdod and among the Philistines?
True or false: Uzziah beats the Philistines, the Arabs in Gur-baal and the Meunites on his own strength alone.

cards.text: The Ammonites start bringing tribute to Uzziah. Meanwhile, word about this king is traveling, and I mean TRAVELING.

cards.question: Uzziah has become exceedingly powerful, and his fame spreads as far as the border of ___.

cards.text: Then Uzziah builds towers in Jerusalem and out in the desert, digs cisterns, keeps farmers working the land because he's a lover of the soil, and gears up a huge army trained for war. Towers. Cisterns. Farms. An army. Friend, this man's to-do list has its OWN to-do list.

cards.question: In Jerusalem, Uzziah puts skillfully designed devices on the towers and corners. They shoot arrows and catapult large ___.

cards.text: But here's the turn, friend. When Uzziah becomes powerful, his arrogance leads to his own destruction, and he walks right into the temple of the LORD.

cards.question: King Uzziah walks right into the temple of the LORD. What is he there to do?

answers.text: Burn incense on the altar himself
Pray for the priests serving there
Bring a gift of gold for the temple

cards.text: Then Azariah the priest goes in after the king, along with eighty brave priests of the LORD. EIGHTY, friend.

cards.question: Azariah and the eighty priests take their stand against King Uzziah. What do they tell him?

answers.text: He has no right to offer incense
He must bring a better offering
He must wait until the evening

cards.text: Then they spell it out for the king: "Only the priests, the descendants of Aaron, are consecrated to burn incense."

cards.question: True or false: the priests tell Uzziah he will still receive honor from the LORD God for this.

cards.text: The priests tell him to leave the sanctuary. But Uzziah, censer in hand, is ENRAGED, and he rages at them right there in the house of the LORD.

cards.question: While King Uzziah rages at the priests before the altar of incense, ___ breaks out on his forehead.

cards.text: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests turn and look at the king. And there it is, right on his forehead.

cards.question: The priests see Uzziah's leprous forehead and rush him out of the temple. Uzziah himself ___ to get out.
True or false: King Uzziah stays a leper until the day of his death.

cards.text: Uzziah lives in isolation, cut off from the house of the LORD. I think this one hurts, friend.

cards.question: With King Uzziah living in isolation, who has charge of the royal palace and governs the people of the land?

cards.text: The rest of Uzziah's acts, from beginning to end, are recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

cards.question: Uzziah rests with his fathers, and the people say, "He was a leper." So where is King Uzziah buried?

answers.text: In a burial field of the kings
In the courts of the temple

cards.text: And his son Jotham reigns in his place.
